<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative and judicial updates:</strong> The Lok Sabha passed a bill to increase the Supreme Court judge strength to 38, while a Constitutional Amendment Bill for women’s reservation failed to pass, and states have raised objections to a new mineral bill curbing their mining tax powers.</li>
